output.reason: This regulation extends the JKK (work accident insurance) contribution adjustment for certain labour-intensive industry companies from PP 7/2025 up to the January 2026 contribution. The employer-paid JKK premium is part of a permanent employee's gross income for PPh 21. Extending the reduced contribution therefore lengthens the period in which a lower JKK amount enters the PPh 21 calculation for employees of these companies. Since the original facility covered contributions through July 2025 and Pasal II refers to August 2025 contributions, the extension appears to cover the August 2025 to January 2026 contribution months.
